question: Can a prompt-conditioned TCMN-author CBAM channel gate trained directly on fixed-read group deletion effects rank held-out group effects better than controls? This small exploratory experiment cannot establish online efficacy.
features: For each verified historical key, normalize its 256x256 early FPN feature across channels as in the existing unweighted contrast; multiply each channel by half the automatic initial foreground-minus-background prototype and area-average each channel to the 64x64 memory grid. Gather verified source-frame token indices and average within each previously fixed 1024-key random deletion group. Sum over all 32 channels must reproduce the existing unweighted group score within 1e-6. Save group channel contributions, automatic prompt prototypes, prior label-free control scores and provenance before opening any outcome.
model: Use the existing TCMN author ChannelGate via PromptContrastChannelAttention initialized for training with 32 channels; use its learned sigmoid channel weights on the per-channel contrast contributions. This is channel reweighting of unweighted-normalized features, not the existing occupancy-trained scoring function and not a claimed full TCMN model. No untrained checkpoint is promoted.
target_and_split: On seq2/3/4 labeled-present development reads only, target pairwise ordering by (full-read Dice minus group-deletion Dice). Skip exactly tied utility pairs and weight reads equally. This target is local, conditional, and very small. Seq9/10 are evaluation only; previously inspected, hence not an untouched test. No label information enters features or inference.
optimization: Fixed seed 20261114; AdamW learning rate 0.01, weight decay 0.0001, 100 full-batch training steps, no checkpoint or hyperparameter selection using validation. Standardize each read's five group scores by their detached standard deviation plus 1e-6; use mean logistic pairwise ranking loss. Save final trained parameters and training loss, plus deterministic repeat. No inference-time confidence gate or threshold.
evaluation: Compare within-read pairwise concordance against the exact uniform-channel score, pre-existing occupancy-trained CBAM, RGB contrast, shuffled and source-age controls on all predeclared present reads. Exclude tied utility pairs; score ties receive half credit. Report each sequence, sample sizes, empty-read exclusions, and whether the utility-trained model beats controls. Historical Lean usage and distributed controls are unavailable in these cached source descriptors and must not be claimed here; prior priority-read matched usage/distributed results are separate. No propagation unless evidence is compelling and a fair online mapping is implemented and verified.
limitations: Only 11 development and 5 validation present reads, groups share reads, utility effects are near zero, validation sequences were previously examined, and patient independence is unknown. This is a feasibility diagnostic rather than an independent efficacy claim. Artifacts remain under the user's Google Drive experiment folder.
